attributes.content:
**EL-HAZ-1.4.1 Forward turn requests to LIN unchanged**

RLCM_Lighting shall copy LeftTurnLightRequest to ReqLeft and RightTurnLightRequest to ReqRight of DEVMLIN01Fr01 for every received TurnLightControl frame, without inverting, latching or filtering them.

description: Obligation of RLCM_Lighting as RLCM in RearLight (EL-HAZ-1.4.1).
Realized by ImplementedRLCM_Lighting: RLCM.on_turn_req_frame() publishes both values to the LIN namespace for every TurnLightControl frame, with no state of its own.
